pptxToVideoPipeline.architecture: A1 Hybrid 16:9 Visual Master PNG background + A2 Native Editable OOXML text/card overlays + AI Explainer Speaker Notes
pptxToVideoPipeline.authoritativePngSyncRule: Use work/design/decks/<deckId>/slides/Slide1.PNG..SlideN.PNG sorted numerically (Slide10.PNG after Slide9.PNG); never extract frames from MP4 or use FFmpeg zoompan.

kinematicLifecycle.name: Spring Entrance
kinematicLifecycle.rule: Translate card stage from -280px -> 0px with spring(damping: 18, stiffness: 120, mass: 0.9)

kinematicLifecycle.name: Sub-Pixel Bezier Drift
kinematicLifecycle.rule: Continuous ~42px camera drift inside 1,152px overscan bleed margin (0px black edge)

kinematicLifecycle.name: Focal ROI Push-In
kinematicLifecycle.rule: 1.08x smooth push-in onto active card, stat counter, or code block ROI

kinematicLifecycle.name: Momentum Exit
kinematicLifecycle.rule: Translate card stage to +380px while EnvironmentalBackground and root vignette stay anchored

layouts.name: Cover Slide
layouts.cameraMotion: 1.35x decoupled background plate + 6% slow Z-axis push-in over slide duration; fixed root vignette (zIndex: 5)
